results.instruction: Stop your car safely on a firm level surface away from traffic.
Set up a warning triangle and turn on the hazard lights.
Switch off the ignition and ensure all passengers exit the vehicle.
Retrieve the spare wheel and replacement tools from the trunk.
Use the provided tool to remove the wheel hubcap.
Use the wrench to loosen the wheel nuts one half to one turn.
Use your foot to help loosen the tight wheel nuts.
Locate the jacking point on the underside of the vehicle.
Place the jack under the jacking point and raise the vehicle.
Jack up the vehicle until the flat tire clears the road.
Remove the wheel nuts and take off the flat tire.
Lift the spare wheel onto the hub and line up the holes.
Replace the wheel nuts and tighten them until they are firm.
Lower the jack until the spare wheel touches the ground.
Use the wrench to tighten the wheel nuts firmly in sequence.
Lower the car completely and remove the jack.
Put the jack and tools back in their proper place.
Store the flat tire so it can be fixed by a Toyota repairer.
Check the wheel nuts after a couple of hundred kilometers of driving.
Do not exceed 80 kilometers per hour when driving with a compact spare wheel.
